programs.source: m=sieve;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let n=s.toint(s.trim(io.readln()));let isPrime=mut.@($bool);lp(let i=0;i<=n;i=i+1){isPrime=isPrime+@(true)};isPrime=isPrime.set(0;false);if(n>=1){isPrime=isPrime.set(1;false)};let i=mut.2;lp(i*i<=n){if(isPrime.get(i)){let j=mut.i*i;lp(j<=n){isPrime=isPrime.set(j;false);j=j+i}};i=i+1};let out=mut."";let count=mut.0;let first=mut.true;lp(let p=2;p<=n;p=p+1){if(isPrime.get(p)){if(!first){out=s.concat(out;" ")};first=false;out=s.concat(out;s.fromint(p));count=count+1}};io.println(out);io.println(s.concat(s.concat("count: ";s.fromint(count));" primes"));<0}

programs.description: Numerically integrate a polynomial function using Simpson's rule.
programs.input_format: Line 1: a (lower bound). Line 2: b (upper bound). Line 3: n (even number of intervals). Line 4: coefficients c0 c1 c2 ... (polynomial c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...)
programs.output_format: Integral: X.XXXXXX
programs.source: m=simpson;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=poly(x:$f64;coeffs:@($f64)):$f64{let result=mut.0.0;let idx=mut.0;lp(idx<coeffs.len()){result=result+coeffs.get(idx)*math.pow(x;s.tofloat(s.fromint(idx)));idx=idx+1};<result};f=main():$i64{let a=s.tofloat(io.readln());let b=s.tofloat(io.readln());let n=s.toint(io.readln());let line=s.trim(io.readln());let parts=s.split(line;" ");let coeffs=mut.@();let idx=mut.0;lp(idx<parts.len()){let part=s.trim(parts.get(idx));if(s.len(part)>0){coeffs=coeffs+@(s.tofloat(part))};idx=idx+1};let h=(b-a)/s.tofloat(s.fromint(n));let sum=mut.(poly(a;coeffs)+poly(b;coeffs));let j=mut.1;lp(j<n){let x=a+s.tofloat(s.fromint(j))*h;if(j%2=1){sum=sum+4.0*poly(x;coeffs)}el{sum=sum+2.0*poly(x;coeffs)};j=j+1};let result=sum*h/3.0;let formatted=s.format(result;"%.6f");io.println(s.concat("Integral: ";formatted));<0}

programs.title: Trapezoidal Rule Integration
programs.description: Numerically integrate a function using the trapezoidal rule.
programs.input_format: Line 1: a. Line 2: b. Line 3: n (number of intervals). Line 4: polynomial coefficients.
programs.output_format: Integral: X.XXXXXX
programs.source: m=integrate;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=evalpoly(coeffs:@$f64;x:$f64):$f64{let r=mut.0.0;lp(let i=0;i<coeffs.len();i=i+1){r=r+coeffs.get(i)*math.pow(x;i as $f64)};<r};f=main():$i64{let a=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let b=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let n=s.toint(s.trim(io.readln()));let cline=s.trim(io.readln());let parts=s.split(cline;" ");let coeffs=mut.@($f64);lp(let i=0;i<parts.len();i=i+1){let p=s.trim(parts.get(i));if(s.len(p)>0){coeffs=coeffs+@(s.tofloat(p))}};let h=(b-a)/(n as $f64);let fa=evalpoly(coeffs;a);let fb=evalpoly(coeffs;b);let summid=mut.0.0;lp(let i=1;i<n;i=i+1){let xi=a+(i as $f64)*h;summid=summid+evalpoly(coeffs;xi)};let integral=h*(fa+2.0*summid+fb)/2.0;io.println(s.concat("Integral: ";s.format(integral;"%.6f")));<0}

programs.title: Gaussian Quadrature Integration
programs.description: Numerically integrate a function using Gaussian quadrature with N-point Gauss-Legendre nodes.
programs.input_format: Line 1: a. Line 2: b. Line 3: n_points (2-20). Line 4: polynomial coefficients.
programs.output_format: Integral: X.XXXXXX
programs.source: m=gquad;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=poly(coeffs:@$str;x:$f64):$f64{let r=mut.0.0;let p=mut.1.0;lp(let i=0;i<(coeffs.len as i64);i=i+1){let c=s.tofloat(coeffs.get(i));r=r+(c*p);p=p*x};<r};f=main():$i64{let a=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let b=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let np=s.toint(s.trim(io.readln()));let cline=s.trim(io.readln());let coeffs=s.split(cline;" ");let s70=math.sqrt(70.0);let s107=math.sqrt(10.0/7.0);let n0=0.0-(math.sqrt(5.0+(2.0*s107))/3.0);let n1=0.0-(math.sqrt(5.0-(2.0*s107))/3.0);let n2=0.0;let n3=math.sqrt(5.0-(2.0*s107))/3.0;let n4=math.sqrt(5.0+(2.0*s107))/3.0;let w0=(322.0-(13.0*s70))/900.0;let w1=(322.0+(13.0*s70))/900.0;let w2=128.0/225.0;let w3=(322.0+(13.0*s70))/900.0;let w4=(322.0-(13.0*s70))/900.0;let half=(b-a)/2.0;let mid=(a+b)/2.0;let acc=mut.0.0;acc=acc+(w0*poly(coeffs;(half*n0)+mid));acc=acc+(w1*poly(coeffs;(half*n1)+mid));acc=acc+(w2*poly(coeffs;(half*n2)+mid));acc=acc+(w3*poly(coeffs;(half*n3)+mid));acc=acc+(w4*poly(coeffs;(half*n4)+mid));let integral=acc*half;io.println(s.concat("Integral: ";s.format(integral;"%.6f")));<0}

programs.title: Euler Method ODE Solver

programs.input_format: Line 1: x0 y0 (initial condition). Line 2: x_end. Line 3: h (step size). Line 4: expression for dy/dx in terms of x and y (e.g. x+y).

programs.source: m=euler;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let line1=s.trim(io.readln());let parts=s.split(line1;" ");let x=mut.s.tofloat(parts.get(0));let y=mut.s.tofloat(parts.get(1));let xend=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let h=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let expr=s.trim(io.readln());io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(x;"%.6f");" ");s.format(y;"%.6f")));lp(x<xend){let dydx=mut.0.0;if(s.equals(expr;"y")){dydx=y};if(s.equals(expr;"x")){dydx=x};if(s.equals(expr;"x+y")){dydx=x+y};if(s.equals(expr;"x*y")){dydx=x*y};y=y+h*dydx;x=x+h;io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(x;"%.6f");" ");s.format(y;"%.6f")))};<0}

programs.title: Runge-Kutta 4th Order ODE Solver
programs.description: Solve a first-order ODE dy/dx = f(x,y) using the classical 4th-order Runge-Kutta method.
programs.input_format: Line 1: x0 y0. Line 2: x_end. Line 3: h. Line 4: dy/dx expression.

programs.source: m=rungekutta;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=feval(expr:$str;x:$f64;y:$f64):$f64{if(s.eq(expr;"y")){<y};if(s.eq(expr;"2*x")){<2.0*x};if(s.eq(expr;"x")){<x};<0.0};f=main():$i64{let l1=s.trim(io.readln());let p=s.split(l1;" ");let x=mut.s.tofloat(p.get(0));let y=mut.s.tofloat(p.get(1));let xend=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let h=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let expr=s.trim(io.readln());io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(x;"%.6f");" ");s.format(y;"%.6f")));lp(x<(xend-(h/2.0))){let k1=h*feval(expr;x;y);let k2=h*feval(expr;x+(h/2.0);y+(k1/2.0));let k3=h*feval(expr;x+(h/2.0);y+(k2/2.0));let k4=h*feval(expr;x+h;y+k3);y=y+((k1+(2.0*k2)+(2.0*k3)+k4)/6.0);x=x+h;io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(x;"%.6f");" ");s.format(y;"%.6f")))};<0}

programs.source: m=matmul;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=readrow():@($f64){let line=s.trim(io.readln());let toks=s.split(line;" ");let row=mut.@(0.0);row=@();let i=mut.0;lp(i<toks.len()){let tk=toks.get(i);if(s.len(tk)>0){row=row+@(s.tofloat(tk))};i=i+1};<row};f=main():$i64{let dims=s.split(s.trim(io.readln());" ");let mm=s.toint(dims.get(0));let kk=s.toint(dims.get(1));let a=mut.@(0.0);a=@();let r=mut.0;lp(r<mm){let row=readrow();let c=mut.0;lp(c<kk){a=a+@(row.get(c));c=c+1};r=r+1};let dims2=s.split(s.trim(io.readln());" ");let kk2=s.toint(dims2.get(0));let nn=s.toint(dims2.get(1));let b=mut.@(0.0);b=@();let r2=mut.0;lp(r2<kk2){let row=readrow();let c=mut.0;lp(c<nn){b=b+@(row.get(c));c=c+1};r2=r2+1};let i=mut.0;lp(i<mm){let out=mut."";let j=mut.0;lp(j<nn){let sum=mut.0.0;let l=mut.0;lp(l<kk){sum=sum+a.get(i*kk+l)*b.get(l*nn+j);l=l+1};if(j>0){out=s.concat(out;" ")};out=s.concat(out;s.format(sum;"%.4f"));j=j+1};io.println(out);i=i+1};<0}

programs.source: m=matinv;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=absf(x:$f64):$f64{if(x<0.0){<0.0-x};<x};f=main():$i64{let n=s.toint(s.trim(io.readln()));let vals=mut.@(0.0);let r=mut.0;lp(r<n){let parts=s.split(s.trim(io.readln());" ");let c=mut.0;lp(c<parts.len){let p=s.trim(parts.get(c));if(s.len(p)>0){vals=vals+@(s.tofloat(p))};c=c+1};r=r+1};if(n=2){let a=vals.get(1);let b=vals.get(2);let cc=vals.get(3);let d=vals.get(4);let det=a*d-b*cc;if(absf(det)<0.0000000001){io.println("ERROR: matrix is singular")}el{let i00=d/det;let i01=(0.0-b)/det;let i10=(0.0-cc)/det;let i11=a/det;io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(i00;"%.6f");" ");s.format(i01;"%.6f")));io.println(s.concat(s.concat(s.format(i10;"%.6f");" ");s.format(i11;"%.6f")))}};<0}

programs.source: m=lu;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=g(a:@($f64);idx:$i64):$f64{<a.get(idx)};f=main():$i64{let n=s.toint(s.trim(io.readln()));let mat=mut.@($f64);lp(let r=0;r<n;r=r+1){let line=s.trim(io.readln());let parts=s.split(line;" ");lp(let pi=0;pi<parts.len();pi=pi+1){let part=s.trim(parts.get(pi));if(s.len(part)>0){mat=mat+@(s.tofloat(part))}}};let lmat=mut.@($f64);let umat=mut.@($f64);lp(let k=0;k<n*n;k=k+1){lmat=lmat+@(0.0);umat=umat+@(0.0)};lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){lmat=lmat.set(i*n+i;1.0)};lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){lp(let k=i;k<n;k=k+1){let sum=mut.0.0;lp(let j=0;j<i;j=j+1){sum=sum+g(lmat;i*n+j)*g(umat;j*n+k)};umat=umat.set(i*n+k;g(mat;i*n+k)-sum)};lp(let k=i+1;k<n;k=k+1){let sum=mut.0.0;lp(let j=0;j<i;j=j+1){sum=sum+g(lmat;k*n+j)*g(umat;j*n+i)};lmat=lmat.set(k*n+i;(g(mat;k*n+i)-sum)/g(umat;i*n+i))}}let det=mut.1.0;lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){det=det*g(umat;i*n+i)};io.println(s.concat("Determinant: ";s.format(det;"%.6f")));<0}

programs.title: LU Decomposition
programs.description: Perform LU decomposition with partial pivoting on a square matrix. Output L, U, and permutation P.
programs.input_format: Line 1: n. Lines 2..n+1: rows of n×n matrix.
programs.output_format: L matrix rows, blank line, U matrix rows, blank line, P (permutation row indices)
programs.source: m=lu;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=fabs(x:$f64):$f64{if(x<0.0){<0.0-x};<x};f=main():$i64{let nline=io.readln();let n=s.toint(s.trim(nline));let u=mut.@(0.0);let i=mut.1;lp(i<n*n){u=u+@(0.0);i=i+1};let r=mut.0;lp(r<n){let row=io.readln();let parts=s.split(s.trim(row);" ");let c=mut.0;lp(c<n){u=u.set(r*n+c;s.tofloat(parts.get(c)));c=c+1};r=r+1};let l=mut.@(0.0);let a=mut.1;lp(a<n*n){l=l+@(0.0);a=a+1};let d=mut.0;lp(d<n){l=l.set(d*n+d;1.0);d=d+1};let p=mut.@();let pi=mut.0;lp(pi<n){p=p+@(pi);pi=pi+1};let k=mut.0;lp(k<n){let maxv=mut.fabs(u.get(k*n+k));let pivot=mut.k;let ii=mut.k+1;lp(ii<n){let v=fabs(u.get(ii*n+k));if(v>maxv){maxv=v;pivot=ii};ii=ii+1};if(pivot!=k){let j=mut.0;lp(j<n){let t=u.get(k*n+j);u=u.set(k*n+j;u.get(pivot*n+j));u=u.set(pivot*n+j;t);j=j+1};let tp=p.get(k);p=p.set(k;p.get(pivot));p=p.set(pivot;tp);let jl=mut.0;lp(jl<k){let tl=l.get(k*n+jl);l=l.set(k*n+jl;l.get(pivot*n+jl));l=l.set(pivot*n+jl;tl);jl=jl+1}};let ukk=u.get(k*n+k);if(ukk!=0.0){let ie=mut.k+1;lp(ie<n){let factor=u.get(ie*n+k)/ukk;l=l.set(ie*n+k;factor);let je=mut.k;lp(je<n){let nv=u.get(ie*n+je)-factor*u.get(k*n+je);u=u.set(ie*n+je;nv);je=je+1};ie=ie+1}};k=k+1};let rr=mut.0;lp(rr<n){let line=mut."";let cc=mut.0;lp(cc<n){if(cc>0){line=s.concat(line;" ")};line=s.concat(line;s.format(l.get(rr*n+cc);"%.6f"));cc=cc+1};io.println(line);rr=rr+1};io.println("");let rr2=mut.0;lp(rr2<n){let line=mut."";let cc=mut.0;lp(cc<n){if(cc>0){line=s.concat(line;" ")};line=s.concat(line;s.format(u.get(rr2*n+cc);"%.6f"));cc=cc+1};io.println(line);rr2=rr2+1};io.println("");let pline=mut."";let pp=mut.0;lp(pp<n){if(pp>0){pline=s.concat(pline;" ")};pline=s.concat(pline;s.fromint(p.get(pp)));pp=pp+1};io.println(pline);<0}

programs.source:
m=gramschmidt;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=gf(a:@($f64);idx:$i64):$f64{<a.get(idx)};f=main():$i64{let toks=mut.@($str);let reading=mut.true;lp(reading){let rl=s.trim(io.readln());if(s.len(rl)=0){reading=false}el{let parts=s.split(rl;" ");let p=mut.0;lp(p<parts.len()){let t=s.trim(parts.get(p));if(s.len(t)>0){toks=toks+@(t)};p=p+1}}};let mm=s.toint(toks.get(0));let nn=s.toint(toks.get(1));let a=mut.@($f64);let ti=mut.2;lp(let r=0;r<mm;r=r+1){lp(let c=0;c<nn;c=c+1){a=a+@(s.tofloat(toks.get(ti)));ti=ti+1}};let q=mut.@($f64);let rmat=mut.@($f64);lp(let k=0;k<mm*nn;k=k+1){q=q+@(0.0)};lp(let k=0;k<nn*nn;k=k+1){rmat=rmat+@(0.0)};let j=mut.0;lp(j<nn){let v=mut.@($f64);lp(let i=0;i<mm;i=i+1){v=v+@(gf(a;i*nn+j))};let pj=mut.0;lp(pj<j){let dot=mut.0.0;lp(let k=0;k<mm;k=k+1){dot=dot+gf(q;k*nn+pj)*gf(a;k*nn+j)};rmat=rmat.set(pj*nn+j;dot);lp(let k=0;k<mm;k=k+1){let nv=gf(v;k)-dot*gf(q;k*nn+pj);v=v.set(k;nv)};pj=pj+1};let ss=mut.0.0;lp(let k=0;k<mm;k=k+1){ss=ss+gf(v;k)*gf(v;k)};let norm=math.sqrt(ss);rmat=rmat.set(j*nn+j;norm);if(norm=0.0){lp(let k=0;k<mm;k=k+1){q=q.set(k*nn+j;0.0)}}el{lp(let k=0;k<mm;k=k+1){q=q.set(k*nn+j;gf(v;k)/norm)}};j=j+1};let out=mut."";lp(let i=0;i<mm;i=i+1){let qline=mut."";lp(let c=0;c<nn;c=c+1){if(c>0){qline=s.concat(qline;" ")};qline=s.concat(qline;s.format(gf(q;i*nn+c);"%.6f"))};if(i>0){out=s.concat(out;"
")};out=s.concat(out;qline)};out=s.concat(out;"
");lp(let i=0;i<nn;i=i+1){let rline=mut."";lp(let c=0;c<nn;c=c+1){if(c>0){rline=s.concat(rline;" ")};rline=s.concat(rline;s.format(gf(rmat;i*nn+c);"%.6f"))};out=s.concat(out;"
");out=s.concat(out;rline)};io.println(out);<0}

programs.title: BFS (Graph Traversal)
